verdict.rationale: Dagster natively supports scheduling recurring jobs via Schedules (cron-based intervals), Sensors for event-driven triggering, and Declarative Automation (including on_cron conditions), all well documented with first-party docs. Community evidence corroborates the product's automation-focused DX. missing for 10: independent hands-on verification specifically of scheduling reliability at scale, and no explicit AI-native agent-driven scheduling workflow example beyond generic docs.
